idea-plugin.name: React Native Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Run React Native commands (run-android, run-ios, Metro) from a tool window without freezing the IDE. Built on OSProcessHandler, IntelliJ's own asynchronous process API, specifically because the leading paid alternative has repeated, recent reports of freezing the IDE and requiring thread dumps to recover.

Includes an Android/iOS device and simulator picker parsed directly from real adb devices / xcrun simctl list devices output.

One-click release bundling and multi-environment profiles are coming in a future release.
